import copy
import math
import unittest

from solution import extract_delivery_cost


class ExtractDeliveryCostTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_successful_costs_are_returned_unchanged(self):
        values = [0, 0.0, 17, 12.5]
        for cost in values:
            with self.subTest(cost=cost):
                returned = extract_delivery_cost({"ok": True, "result": {"cost": cost}})
                self.assertEqual(returned, cost)
                self.assertIs(type(returned), type(cost))

    def test_exact_false_returns_none_without_requiring_result(self):
        self.assertIsNone(extract_delivery_cost({"ok": False}))
        self.assertIsNone(extract_delivery_cost({"ok": False, "result": "malformed"}))

    def test_payload_is_not_mutated(self):
        payload = {"ok": True, "result": {"cost": 4.5, "other": [1, 2]}, "extra": 9}
        before = copy.deepcopy(payload)
        self.assertEqual(extract_delivery_cost(payload), 4.5)
        self.assertEqual(payload, before)

    def test_invalid_ok_and_payload(self):
        bad_payloads = [
            None,
            [],
            {},
            {"ok": None},
            {"ok": 0},
            {"ok": 1},
            {"ok": "true"},
        ]
        for payload in bad_payloads:
            with self.subTest(payload=payload):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    extract_delivery_cost(payload)

    def test_malformed_successful_response(self):
        bad_payloads = [
            {"ok": True},
            {"ok": True, "result": None},
            {"ok": True, "result": {}},
            {"ok": True, "result": {"cost": None}},
            {"ok": True, "result": {"cost": True}},
            {"ok": True, "result": {"cost": -1}},
            {"ok": True, "result": {"cost": math.inf}},
            {"ok": True, "result": {"cost": -math.inf}},
            {"ok": True, "result": {"cost": math.nan}},
            {"ok": True, "result": {"cost": "5"}},
        ]
        for payload in bad_payloads:
            with self.subTest(payload=payload):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    extract_delivery_cost(payload)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
